subject: general
question: Six cubes, each with an edge 4.5 cm are joined end to end. Find the total surface area of the resulting cuboid.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total faces of 6 independent cubes = 6 × 6 = 36.

When joined end-to-end, 5 joints are formed, and each joint hides 2 faces.

Total faces hidden = 5 × 2 = 10.

Total remaining faces = 36 − 10 = 26.

Total Surface Area = 26 × (4.5)² = 26 × 20.25 = 526.5 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 526.5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Edge of each cube (a) = 4.5 cm

When 6 cubes are joined end to end, the dimensions of the resulting cuboid are:

Length (l) = 6 × 4.5 = 27 cm

Breadth (b) = 4.5 cm

Height (h) = 4.5 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68e4fd16582525daba645a8c108427bd81ccde777548262953651fbdb2374a6d.png] 

Formula: Total Surface Area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (27 × 4.5 + 4.5 × 4.5 + 4.5 × 27)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (121.5 + 20.25 + 121.5)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (263.25)

⇒ TSA = 526.5 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 526.5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The volume (V) of the resulting cuboid is given by l × b × h. Here, V = 27 × 4.5 × 4.5 = 546.75 cm³.

Lateral Surface Area

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) excludes the top and bottom faces. Formula: LSA = 2h(l + b) = 2 × 4.5 × (27 + 4.5) = 283.5 cm².

Diagonal of Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed in a cuboid is its diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²).</p
